forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M8C4ZXSCRCRGP0WQ09YNC5H3
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8780'
+title: 'Scroll 4: mount the real rows at rest over several frames'
+---
+From spike ^fa3j934 (2026-11-26). With static rows in motion, the largest hitch (44 to 75 ms) comes when the list stops and all rows in view mount their real EK editors in one frame.
+
+## What
+- [ ] When the transcript comes to rest, mount the real rows a few at a time (for example 1 or 2 rows for each frame), the rows nearest the center of the view first. Use the display link or the SwiftUI frame updates, not a timer or a delay.
+- [ ] If the list moves again before all rows are real, stop the mounts, and keep the static rows.
+- [ ] The row that gets the focus or the mouse mounts at once.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] In the flick trace of the spike harness, the largest hitch at rest is 17 ms or less (one 60 Hz frame), and the main-thread time does not grow.
+- [ ] No row changes its height when it mounts.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Unit tests with a manual frame driver (no clock): after each frame, at most N rows are real; the order is from the center out; a new motion stops the mounts.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with 0 failures and 0 warnings. The full IntegrationTests run passes (hosted, with start and end lines).
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #perf
\ No newline at end of file
